review_mode: independent read-only replay of frozen source and sealed native raw evidence
reviewer: separate review agent; no file edits and no SIMLOX invocation
limits: The event log has two position-level backorders, one at base and one at depot. StockTotalResults.NBO integrates the single end-customer base wait of 5.166667 hours, not the sum of both position durations.
Station-specific inventory, physical item identity and absence of terminal transit come from the complete event log; stock report data is aggregate.
The native event log rounds fractional-hour timestamps.
The runner verifies GUI process identity and active session; GUI visual content was not sampled.
The author validator was added after the native run as a read-only replay, not an invocation-hashed prelaunch source.
This case does not establish multilevel allocation or FIFO across multiple backorders.
